title: Partying is Such Sweet Sorrow
start: Talk to Pumpkin Pete who was located north-west of Port Sarim.

steps.t: For players who had completed the 2009 Halloween event, there was additional dialogue throughout this event if Eek was taken.
For players who had completed the 2006 Halloween event, there was additional dialogue at points during this event if the Jack lantern mask was worn.

Talk to Pumpkin Pete near the portal to start the quest and then enter the portal. Talk to him inside, and he will tell you to talk to people around the house to help prepare for the party. The parts can be done in any order.
They tell you that they are the backup singers for the band Adamantite Damsel and that they need a special drink called moonshine to help their singing voices.

They tell you that moonshine must be made fresh and suggest that you make it for them. However, none of them can remember the whole recipe, so they ask you to gather ingredients and then each of them may be able to remember a bit of a recipe. Anything that Helga tells you will certainly be wrong as her memory is not as good.

Search the table just south of them to get the ingredients. Moira remembers that the leaves are used to strain the other liquid ingredients. Helga remembers that the blood is never first (or always last), but she is always wrong, so the blood is first. Greta remembers that the ground bone is last.

After gathering the inredients, make the moonshine in this order:
# Use pile of evil leaves on empty moonshine vial
# Use big bottle of blood on the strained moonshine vial
# Use big bottle of fear on the unfinished moonshine
# Use pile of ground bones on the unfinished moonshine to make moonshine
Making a mistake in mixing the drink causes the player to start over.
Go back to the werewolves to complete this task.

First talk to Grim Reaper, who is upstairs, to the east. He will explain that he is very anxious because his favourite musician, Zabeth Corvid, is present at the party downstairs and indirectly hint the player about his inability to talk to Zabeth as he is too shy. The player will offer to get Zabeth's autograph for Grim, but Grim will warn the player that because Zabeth was heavily drunk when he died, he accidentally stumbled a few seconds into the future, which can make conversations with him difficult.

Head downstairs, to the south-eastern room, where you will find Zabeth. Since he is a few seconds into the future, what he says will not seem to make sense, but the player must choose the option that makes sense for Zabeth to have responded to it in the way he did.

Choose the following options in the dialogue:
 class="wikitable lighttable"

!Sequence | Option | Response | 1 | Hello, enjoying the party? | *Hic* Hello (player's name) *Hic* Awesome PARTAY! I'm having a BLAST! Man, *hic* thanks for asking. You three are alright. *Hic* | 2 | So, what do people call you? | Oh Yeah! I'm the dark *Hic* master of music! | 3 | Sheesh, you're an idiot. | Woooah, you're well rude, dude! | 4 | Sorry, how about I make it up to you with another drink? | Nah, it's alright, I forgive you. *Hic* Sounds good to me *Hic* You three are alright. | 5 | Exactly how drunk are you? | *Hic* I am a space kebbit: look at my shiny green fur! *Hic* | 6 | A vampire and a werewolf walk into a bar... | That must have hurt! | 7 | Do you know Grim? | Woah, yeah: course I know Grim. I met him once. *Hic* Top guy, if a little on the skinny side. | 8 | Can I get a million XP? (optional) | Nice try.
He refuses to answer. | 9 | Can I get an autograph for Grim? | Sure, no problem. *Hic*
Zabeth will agree, and give you his autograph. Bring this back to Grim, and he will thank you and hang the autograph in his room.
If you have Eek the Spider in your backpack, your conversations with Minstrel Web will be a little more humorous and interesting, as Eek chimes into the conversation.
The spiders are hidden around the house. Two are on the ground floor. Six are upstairs.

The quickest way is to talk to Allan (the raven next to Minstrel Web) and ask him to reset, if you have moved any of the spiders, then click on the following colours:
• Turquoise
• Green
• Red
• Purple
• Orange
This is only one of many ways to solve the puzzle. Shown here is an example of the fastest (5-move) solution.
Talk to Minstrel Web again once all the spiders are on their correct spots to complete this task.
Speak to Pumpkin Pete once you've completed all the tasks to finish the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
p: Message that appeared when logging in during this event.

get_inside.text: Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.

Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.
Using the teleport option on the Arc Journal obtained from Sharkborne. Requires completion of Impressing the Locals.
Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south-east.
